panels.visual: Sick pilgrims with walking sticks arriving at a sanctuary in green hills; a statue of Asclepius, god of healing, holding a staff with a snake
panels.caption: Long ago, sick people travelled to Epidaurus to ask Asclepius, god of healing, to cure them.

panels.visual: Patients asleep on mats in a long hall at night; above one, a dream of the bearded god with a snake
panels.caption: They slept in a holy hall and hoped the god would visit them in a dream.

panels.visual: Around 340 BC: builders cutting curved rows of stone seats into a hillside
panels.caption: Around 340 BC the Greeks built a huge theatre here, cut into the hillside.

panels.visual: The finished theatre packed with spectators watching masked actors on the round stage floor
panels.caption: It seats about 14,000 people, and plays are still put on here today.

panels.visual: A masked actor standing in the middle of the round stage, speaking softly; gentle sound ripples rising up the rows
panels.caption: Here is the famous part. An actor speaks in a normal voice in the middle...

panels.visual: A girl in the very top row cupping her ear, amazed, the tiny actor far below
panels.caption: ...and you can hear every word from the top row, with no microphone.

panels.visual: A tour guide dropping a coin on the stone circle in the middle, a little sound wave rising
panels.caption: Guides say you can even hear a coin drop from the top.

panels.visual: Glauka the owl raising one eyebrow, holding up a coin
panels.caption: Don't believe it until you have tried it yourself.

panels.visual: A diagram-like drawing: the stepped rows of seats drawn like the teeth of a comb, sound waves meeting them
panels.caption: Scientists think the stepped rows of seats work like a sieve for sound.

panels.visual: Low rumbly sound blobs labelled WIND, FEET and TUMMY getting caught on the steps while a clear thin ribbon of voice flows up past them
panels.caption: Low rumbles of wind and shuffling feet get caught. The clear sound of a voice gets through.

panels.visual: Ancient builders scratching their heads over a drawing on a wax tablet
panels.caption: Did the builders plan it? Nobody knows. Maybe they just copied what worked.

panels.visual: Two girls sitting in the top row with a coin, Glauka beside them, the empty stage far below
panels.caption: Find the stone circle in the middle. Drop a coin. Listen from the top.
